interface.name: ferese_shell_manager_v1

description.summary: create a capability-scoped Ferese shell controller

interface.description: This private global is visible only to clients granted the shell-control capability. It does not assign a Wayland surface role.

interface.name: ferese_shell_v1
interface.description: Window, workspace, and output identifiers are unsigned 64-bit values encoded as high and low 32-bit words. Each snapshot atomically replaces the prior shell view after snapshot_end.

arg.name: focused
arg.summary: one when this is the focused output

arg.name: output_hi
arg.summary: zero when the workspace has no output

arg.name: output_lo
arg.summary: zero when the workspace has no output

arg.name: visible
arg.summary: one when displayed on its output

arg.name: focused
arg.summary: one when visible on the focused output

description.summary: marks completion of initial protocol setup

event.name: config_begin

description.summary: complete validated configuration for live reload

event.description: Sent only after the compositor has accepted the complete configuration. Followed by bounded UTF-8 chunks and config_end. Clients apply only the completed source, preserving their current appearance if parsing fails.

event.name: toggle_keybinding_guide

description.summary: toggle the shortcut hint on the focused output

event.description: Explicit requests are independent of the guide-at-login preference.

description.summary: toggle the display mode chooser on the focused output

event.name: monitor_state_changed
event.description: Query the output IPC inventory after reconciliation. This includes disabled monitors and mirror targets without a logical wl_output.

event.name: window_geometry

description.summary: window layout rectangle for workspace previews

event.description: Follows its window event inside a snapshot. Coordinates are compositor logical coordinates at the layout target, independent of animations. Width and height are positive. An omitted event means unavailable geometry.

request.name: move_window_to_workspace

description.summary: move an identified window without switching workspaces

request.description: Both IDs must exist and belong to the same output. A stale ID is rejected.

event.name: binding_mode

description.summary: active keyboard binding mode inside a snapshot

event.description: Sent between snapshot_begin and snapshot_end. An empty name denotes the default bindings. Other names must be displayed with an Escape exit hint until the next snapshot replaces them.

description.summary: toggle the launcher on the focused output

request.name: thumbnail
request.description: Only available on the private shell connection. Returns straight RGBA8 pixels in an anonymous file, at most 320 by 168 pixels. Protected surfaces and locked sessions are never captured. The token identifies the invocation; the shell must discard replies from closed invocations.
